_comment: CastaliaB: config/castalia.json with hart 0 turned all the way up. The chip shape, peripheral set, memory map and package are byte-for-byte Castalia's; the only difference is the orchestrator's ISA and privilege set, which carries every selectable isa.* extension plus U-mode and PMP at the shipped 16 entries, so the soft centre hart is the one that runs anything the tiles cannot. isa.minimalTiles stays true, so harts 1-4 are rv32iac: since 2026-09-12 the generator's tile split covers every knob under isa.* and priv.* (one TILE_ENABLE_* constant each), so nothing turned on below reaches the hardened tile netlist except A, C and the trap CSRs. This configuration is the regression test for that: it is the config on which the older three-constant split was measured putting Zfinx, Zkn and PMP inside the macro (P10 finding F1). Build with: make chip CONFIG=config/castalia_b.json ; prove with: make verify CONFIG=config/castalia_b.json
